mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to potential tightening by the Federal Reserve, which can negatively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to increased wages and inflationary pressure, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months indicates strong consumer demand, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansionary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% year-over-year, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a weakening in demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% year-over-year and Industrial Production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% month-over-month, the combination signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < 2% and INDPRO decreases > 1% MoM
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.
